events.title: New initiative launched to shield terrorism victims from online harm
events.summary: The UN has launched a new initiative to protect victims of terrorist attacks from online harm and re-traumatisation, drawing on harrowing survivor accounts, from the Nova Music Festival in Israel to an attack on a FIFA World Cup final view...

events.title: Somalia: Humanitarian aid cuts leave millions of children vulnerable to hunger
